title: Playboy Magazine July 1987 - Complete with Centerfold, Acceptable
descriptionText: The product is a complete issue of Playboy Magazine from July 1987, featuring a centerfold as well as illustrations and articles on various topics related to men's interest, entertainment, art & photography, and pop culture. The magazine, published in the United States, caters to a wide range of interests for its readers, making it a popular choice for those looking for a mix of entertainment and lifestyle content.
